notes.title: TWIN FLAMES Joins MGN 2025 Steam Sale!
notes.content:
We’re ecstatic to share that TWIN FLAMES is featured in the MGN 2025 Steam Sale, alongside the incredible IGU! Step into the enchanting world of TWIN FLAMES, where Savitri and Satyavan’s destinies intertwine in a co-op puzzle adventure. Tackle hex-grid challenges, immerse yourself in a breathtaking low-poly realm, and experience a heartfelt story of love and fate. 💞

🎮 [b]What makes TWIN FLAMES special?[/b]

[list]
[*] Engaging co-op gameplay for you and a friend
[*] A captivating narrative of two souls bound by destiny
[*] Stunning visuals that bring a mystical world to life
[/list]

[b][u]The MGN 2025 Steam Sale is live now![/u][/b] Visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/MGN2025?tab=1]MGN steam sale[/url] to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084560/TWIN_FLAMES/]TWIN FLAMES[/url].

[b]Call to Action:[/b] Don’t wait—[b]Wishlist TWIN FLAMES on Steam today[/b] to support the game and stay updated on its journey! Let’s ignite the flames together!
